📦 Future / Unused Features ▶
Shelved features — not currently active in the app but saved here so you can implement or remove them later.
🏆 App Tour Badges
Achievement badge system shown during app onboarding. Was part of the original app tour flow. Code is preserved in the archive for future gamification features.
✨ Character Animations
Animated avatar/character system that was explored early on. Shelved in favor of the Millie pet widget. Could be revived for a more personalized experience.
🎨 Color Mix Game
A fun color mixing mini-game that was removed. Functions are stubbed out (renderColorMix etc.) to prevent reference errors — can be re-implemented in Workshop.

🚪 The Hatch ▶
Program all the prompts for each Hatch mode. Use AI to refresh them whenever you want.
🎯 Missions
Short, specific challenges. You accept or skip.
🎲 Chaos Categories & Actions
Each category has a pool of actions. The wheel spins and lands on one randomly.
📻 Transmissions
Fiction-flavored nudges from Brindleport. Write them yourself — or get Claude to write a batch.
⚡ Shock Challenges
Physical only. 60-second timer fires on deploy.
🎭 The Cast — Characters
Build your cast. Each character gets their own pool of scene prompts. The Hatch will pull from them.
💬 Spark Prompts
Four modes: Spiritual, Connect, Curious, Reflect. Add or remove prompts from each.
